name: SATX
fix_description: In destroyPoolToken, burning/destroying tokens from the LP pair and calling sync() manipulates the price. Fix: add access control or time-lock to prevent exploitation in same block.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a multi-step flash-loan-based attack involving PancakePair callbacks, liquidity provisioning, pair reserve manipulation via skim/sync, and fee-on-transfer swap handling. It requires understanding AMM pair mechanics and protocol-specific token behavior, but the PoC is still relatively compact and not deeply dependent on obscure internals.
